ppe.title: Hardware offload visibility
ppe.description: Keep only the first packets of selected B4 flows on the CPU path so classification can see both directions.
ppe.beginnerSafety: Per-flow exclusion keeps hardware offload available for unrelated traffic. Turning this on does not disable hardware acceleration globally.
ppe.modeExclude: Selected B4 ports use a bounded firmware exclusion window. A controlled proof is still required before hold, automatic Discovery, canary, or promotion are enabled.
ppe.modeMonitor: Monitoring only. B4 detects capability and visibility risk but does not install exclusion rules.
ppe.unsupported: This router did not prove the required Keenetic PPE target and connskip capability. No rules were installed.
ppe.noGlobalClaim: B4 does not automatically disable global offload. The advanced test only verifies the active per-flow exclusion generation against a controlled endpoint.
